description: This PHP file defines a class 'sysinfo' that provides various system information retrieval methods for HP-UX systems. It includes functions to obtain hostname, IP address, kernel version, uptime, users connected, load averages, CPU info, hardware components, network statistics, memory usage, filesystems, and distribution information.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class that provides methods to retrieve various system information on HP-UX systems.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Retrieves the current server's hostname or virtual host name.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical hostname by executing the 'hostname' command.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the system, either from environment variable or by resolving hostname.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates system uptime in seconds by parsing 'uptime' command output.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Returns load average values over 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU information such as model name and speed by reading '/proc/cpuinfo'.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Returns details of PCI devices by parsing '/proc/pci'.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Returns information about IDE devices from '/proc/ide'.

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Returns details of SCSI devices from '/proc/scsi/scsi'.

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Returns connected USB device details from '/proc/bus/usb/devices'.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Placeholder for SBus devices, currently not implemented.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers RAM and swap memory information from '/proc/meminfo' and '/proc/swaps'.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Returns mounted filesystem details by parsing 'mount' and 'df' outputs.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename representing the distribution.
